summary: Full backend + frontend testing of GREM. 13/13 pytest backend tests passed (health, wallet incl. invalid 422, token incl. invalid 422, intelligence, tokens list ~36, and filters: q/risk/pump_fun/new_only/sort by market_cap desc, min_liquidity). Frontend Playwright coverage validated Home (hero, CTAs, feature cards 0-3, nav links, X/Telegram social links to GREMTracker), Tracker (wallet-example click -> loading state 'GREM IS LOOKING' -> wallet-summary, holding-card, Trading Profile, intelligence-card, pattern-item, signals-disclaimer; invalid address shows 'valid Solana address' error), Token (/token) example loads token-header, risk-panel, creator-panel, status-panel, Intelligence (/intelligence) example loads intelligence-card + trader-profile, Tokens discovery (/tokens) has tokens-table with 36 token-row, search/sort/risk/pumpfun/new toggles present, clicking a row navigates to /token?mint=... and auto-analyzes, $GREM page shows 'Coming soon' placeholders and no fake tokenomics, Docs shows Coming Soon, mobile (390px) nav-hamburger opens mobile-menu. No client console errors (only preload warning + expected 422 from invalid-address test).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /grem-logo.jpg is preloaded via <link rel=preload> but not used within a few seconds — consider removing the preload or adding a matching `as` attribute to silence the warning.
